critical_code_review_comments: ShufflingDeck.jsx line 225: z-index is computed as `DECK_SIZE - ((i + cycle) % DECK_SIZE)` which correctly yields integers (1..5). Setting zIndex via the framer-motion `style` prop rather than `animate` avoids interpolation — confirmed integer values in DOM (getComputedStyle().zIndex returned strings like '4','3','2','1','5' with zero decimals).

ShufflingDeck.jsx line 217-220: `if (landed && i !== 0) return null` correctly unmounts the 4 non-winner cards on land, so no stray backing cards can peek out. Post-land, `[data-testid="shuffling-deck"]` is itself unmounted (replaced by RestaurantCard/spin-result-card), so the setInterval cycle is auto-cleaned up by React on unmount as well as by the effect's `if (landed) return` guard — no interval leak.

Home.jsx runShuffle (line 257-262) and runCrawlShuffle (line 443-449) both implement identical `nextFlash()` helpers using Math.random + last-index avoidance. Sampled sequence during a real deal: [Catria, Russ & Daughters, In Common NYC, Roma Pizza, Capizzi, Junior's, Bellhop, Chi Restaurant, Jacob's Pickles, Daily Provisions] — clearly random, not walking pool order.

FateActionsDropdown.jsx trigger uses Share2 icon + 'Share your fate' label (line 111). The inner text-share item is now labelled 'Share as text' with testid `fate-action-share-text` unchanged (line 75). No duplicate 'Share your fate' inside the menu (verified programmatically).
